Lemma
[Koszul formula]

↗ def:dc-ch2-3-4 ↗ cor:dc-ch2-3-3

1. ch2:3.6If $ abla $ is symmetric and metric-compatible, then, for all $X,Y,Z\in \mathcal{X}(M)$, \[ egin{aligned} 2\langle Z, abla _YX angle ={}& X\langle Y,Z angle +Y\langle Z,X angle -Z\langle X,Y angle \ & -\langle [X,Z],Y angle -\langle [Y,Z],X angle -\langle [X,Y],Z angle . \end{aligned} ag {9} \]
Proof

↗ def:dc-ch2-3-4 ↗ cor:dc-ch2-3-3 \sketch Apply (4) to the three cyclic orderings of $X,Y,Z$. Add the first two identities, subtract the third, and replace differences of covariant derivatives using symmetry (5). Symmetry of the metric gives (9).

□
